checks.name: sequential resubmit with identical fields (hold released, owner submits again) is the same intent/generation
concurrent duplicate (original still in flight while the resubmit lands) leaves one intent, generation 1
resubmit after the owner edits the kept form (forwarding mode) replaces the same intent (generation 2), never a second operation
existing waiting_platform intent: identical resubmit returns it unchanged (no observable change for mutationEvidence to see)
